quote: Halliburton (NYSE: HAL) announced today it was awarded a multibillion-dollar contract by YPF to provide bundled unconventional completions services in the Vaca Muerta… Under the contract, Halliburton will utilize its ZEUS® electric fracturing services in its first international deployment.
note: Opened Halliburton English primary; multibillion-dollar / ZEUS first international / OCTIV Auto Frac confirmed. CapEx-fill enter USD 2bn soft floor of multibillion.
